audience.text: TypeScript and Node.js developers building server-side or client-side applications that require programmatic Excel workbook processing.

capabilities.text: Load existing .xlsx files and save workbooks back to .xlsx using Workbook.load() and Workbook.save().
capabilities.title: Load and save Excel workbooks

capabilities.text: Read and write cell values, formulas, and shared strings using Cell.putValue(), Cell.setFormula(), and Worksheet.getCell2().
capabilities.title: Read and write cell data

capabilities.text: Apply font, fill, border, alignment, number format, and protection settings via Style, Font, Fill, Border, and Alignment objects.
capabilities.title: Apply comprehensive cell and worksheet formatting

capabilities.text: Set column widths, row heights, merged cells, hidden rows, and auto filters using Worksheet methods.
capabilities.title: Configure worksheet features

capabilities.text: Insert hyperlinks, comments, and data validation rules on cell ranges using Worksheet.addHyperlink(), Worksheet.addComment(), and Worksheet.addDataValidation().
capabilities.title: Add hyperlinks, comments, and data validation

capabilities.text: Add color scale, data bar, and icon set conditional formatting rules using Worksheet.addConditionalFormat().
capabilities.title: Apply conditional formatting rules

capabilities.text: Export workbook data to CSV, JSON, and Markdown strings using Workbook.toCsv(), Workbook.toJson(), and Workbook.toMarkdown().
capabilities.title: Export to text formats

capabilities.text: Load HTML files as workbooks and render workbooks to HTML using Workbook.load() and Workbook.toHtml().
capabilities.title: Import and export HTML

limitations.text: Text export (CSV, JSON, Markdown) returns a string and does not include direct file-writing helpers.
Text export is one-way; there is no corresponding import path to reconstruct a Workbook from CSV, JSON, or Markdown.
The library does not support all Aspose.Cells for .NET features; it is a subset FOSS edition.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic Excel workbook creation, editing, and conversion in TypeScript without Microsoft Excel installed.
Supports exporting workbooks to HTML, CSV, JSON, and Markdown for reporting and data interchange.
Provides full formatting control over cells and worksheets through Style, Font, Fill, Border, and Alignment objects.
Allows advanced worksheet features such as auto filters, data validation, conditional formatting, hyperlinks, comments, and merged cells.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells-FOSS-for-TypeScript is a free, open-source TypeScript library for creating, loading, editing, and saving Excel .xlsx workbooks without requiring Microsoft Excel.

uncertainties: Whether the library supports encryption or password protection beyond Workbook.protect() and Workbook.isProtected() is not evident from the fact set.
The exact set of supported image formats for Workbook.images and Worksheet.addImage() is not specified.
Whether the library supports chart creation and manipulation beyond Workbook.charts and Worksheet.charts references is unclear.
The behavior of Workbook.load() when auto-detecting HTML input versus XLSX is not detailed beyond example:003.
Whether shared strings are fully round-tripped during save/load cycles is not confirmed.
The scope of supported formula functions in Cell.setFormula() is not listed.
Whether the library supports pivot tables or other advanced Excel features is not stated.
The exact Node.js version requirement beyond '18 or later' and compatibility with older LTS versions is uncertain.
